en: Fixed `/autofix-pr` and other cloud-session commands saying to retry or install the Claude GitHub App when no GitHub account is connected; they now point to `/web-setup` or the web connect page
zh: 修复了 `/autofix-pr` 及其他云 session 命令在未连接 GitHub 账号时提示重试或安装 Claude GitHub App 的问题；现在会指向 `/web-setup` 或网页连接页面
